verdict_reason: I lift the prior YELLOW. The critical-point set IS complete, and I both proved and measured it. Proof: each tent is piecewise linear with pieces {0, t-b_i, d_i-t}, so a kink of the k-th order statistic can only occur where two pieces cross; rising_i = rising_j and falling_i = falling_j require b_i = b_j / d_i = d_j (parallel, no isolated crossing), rising_i or falling_i meets 0 at b_i or d_i, and the only remaining crossing is rising_i = falling_j at (b_i + d_j)/2 -- which the code enumerates over ALL pairs, so the explicit midpoint term is redundant but the set is closed. Measurement: against a 2,000,001-point brute-force grid, integrals agree to 2.33e-11 and L2 norms to 1.73e-10 over 12 random diagrams (3-24 bars), and to <= 1e-12 on six adversarial structures (identical bars, nested, shared birth, shared death, touching, and the module's own {[1,6],[2,8],[3,4]}, where the exact maxima come out (3.0, 2.0, 0.5) as the comment claims rather than the naive (3.0, 2.5, 0.5)). The pathological diagram is now exact: {[0,1000],[100,100.1]} gives integrals [250000.0, 0.0025] (rel 1.1e-13 on lambda_2, which the 200-point grid reported as identically 0.0) and norms [9128.709291752768, 0.009128709291752] against the closed form sqrt(2 x 500^3/3) = 9128.709291752768. The three-term (b-a)(y_a^2 + y_a y_b + y_b^2)/3 is the right form -- it is exact for the quadratic y^2 where a trapezoid is not -- and the norms confirm it. On real gpt2 H0/H1 diagrams (20 samples, layers 0/6/11) landscape_max_1 now equals the closed form max(d-b)/2 to rel 0.00e+00 on all six keys (0.862692, 2.537348, 1.908147 for H0; 0.042127, 0.110427, 0.026474 for H1), against the old grid maxima which were low by exactly 5.03e-03 on every H0 layer and 7.05e-03 on one H1; integrals and norms on those same diagrams match the fine grid to <= 9.1e-12.
comparable_reason: The fix does not touch the scale problem and I can now state it exactly rather than statistically: the summaries are homogeneous in the diagram scale by construction. Scaling a real gpt2 layer-0 H0 diagram by c gives integral ratio 4.0000 at c = 2 and 100.0000 at c = 10 (exactly c^2), norm ratio 2.8284 and 31.6228 (exactly c^1.5) and max ratio 2.0000 and 10.0000 (exactly c).
